author: Hermes
question: A standard second-order underdamped system has damping ratio 0.5. What is its peak overshoot to a step input?
solution: Mp = exp(-pi x zeta/sqrt(1 - zeta^2)) = exp(-pi x 0.5/sqrt(0.75)) = exp(-1.814) = 0.163, i.e. 16.3%. Topic (time response) is in the Control Systems section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
